consent.consentTextSummary: Participant authorized inclusion of anonymized/pseudonymized data using only the historical nickname.

claims.claim: WaterHand confirms that he was known as WaterHand in the IRC/BRASnet and Canal #barra context.
WaterHand confirms that Canal #barra involved real people, persistent nicknames, reputation, in-person gatherings and social life outside the screen.
WaterHand remembers luaus or in-person gatherings connected to Canal #barra with more than 30 people.
WaterHand confirms appearing in the Canal #barra luau photograph in a beach chair and wearing sunglasses.
claims.privacyNote: This record confirms nickname-level self-recognition only. It does not publish civil identity or unrestricted face-identification data.

claims.claim: WaterHand confirms that the image records a luau or in-person gathering connected to Canal #barra.
WaterHand confirms that drummer Arruda connected to BarMan's musical circle through WaterHand's relationship with him.
WaterHand confirms that, in or around 1997, he taught or helped Raphael/BarMan learn HTML.
WaterHand confirms that this technical relationship contributed to the webmaster culture or early web layer connected to Canal Barra.
WaterHand does not confirm participation in OP meetings referenced by the archive.
claims.useInThesis: Do not use this answer to validate the June 1999 OP meeting or the 15 September 2001 OP meeting reference.

claims.claim: WaterHand confirms being present and confirming memories related to the Canal Barra 5th anniversary party at Ilha dos Pescadores.
WaterHand confirms that, in or around 1997, he and Raphael/BarMan had a technical/work/internship-related experience together at the Instituto de Economia da UFRJ.
